results.question: How do I install Claude Code on Windows?
results.answer:
Here's a step-by-step guide for installing Claude Code on Windows [[986841103]]:

---

## Step 1: Get Access to Claude Code

First, you need to obtain access to Claude Code. See the [Purchase Claude Code and Claude API Access](https://answers.atlassian.syr.edu/wiki/spaces/ITSAI/pages/540934169/Purchase+Claude+Code+and+Claude+API+Access) page for your options [[986841103]].

---

## Step 2: Install Claude Code & Development Tools

An automated PowerShell script (`Install-DevTools.ps1`) handles the entire installation. It auto-detects your system architecture (AMD64 or ARM64) and installs the following tools [[986841103]]:

| Tool | Version | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Node.js | 24.12.0 | Portable/embedded |
| Git Portable | 2.52.0 | Includes Git Bash |
| Python Embeddable | 3.14.3 | Skipped if system Python detected |
| VS Code Portable | Latest | Skipped if already installed |
| GitHub Desktop | Latest | Visual interface for Git |
| PowerShell 7 | Latest | Via winget; skipped if already installed |
| Claude Code | Latest | Always installs locally |

> **Note:** Tools install to your **OneDrive** by default (for sync across devices). Claude Code always installs locally at `%USERPROFILE%\.local\bin`.

### 2a. Set the PowerShell Execution Policy
Open PowerShell and run:
```powershell
Set-ExecutionPolicy -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned -Scope CurrentUser
```

### 2b. Download the Script
Download [`Install-DevTools.ps1`](https://answers.atlassian.syr.edu/wiki/spaces/ITSAI/pages/986841103/Claude+Code+Setup) and save it (e.g., to your Downloads folder).

### 2c. Remove the "Mark of the Web"
Windows blocks scripts downloaded from the internet. Unblock the file using **one** of these methods:

- **PowerShell (recommended):**
  ```powershell
  Unblock-File -Path "$HOME\Downloads\Install-DevTools.ps1"
  ```
- **File Explorer:** Right-click the file → Properties → check **Unblock** → click OK.

### 2d. Run the Script
```powershell
# Install all tools to OneDrive (default)
.\Install-DevTools.ps1
```

---

## Step 3: Configure Claude Code

Once installed, connect Claude Code to your SU account [[986841103]]:

1. Open a terminal and type `claude`
2. Choose your preferred text display style.
3. Select **"Anthropic Console account"** (option 2) for your login method.
4. A browser window will open — sign in with your **`netid@syr.edu`** credentials. If prompted, select the **Syracuse University** organization.
5. **Authorize Claude Code** in the browser.
6. Return to the terminal and press **Enter twice** to accept and trust the folder.

✅ **You're all set!** Claude Code is ready to use.

---

## Troubleshooting Tips

- **Script won't run?** You may need to bypass the execution policy for a single session:
  ```powershell
  Set-ExecutionPolicy -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Scope Process
  ```
  Or from Command Prompt: `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\Install-DevTools.ps1`
- **32-bit systems** are not supported — only AMD64 and ARM64.
- **No OneDrive?** Use the `-Location Local` flag when running the script.
- **Network issues?** Some networks may block downloads — check your internet connectivity.

---

## Sources
- [Claude Code Setup](https://answers.atlassian.syr.edu/wiki/spaces/ITSAI/pages/986841103/Claude+Code+Setup) [[986841103]]

results.question: How do I create a new mentor on the Clementine platform?
results.answer:
Here's a step-by-step guide to creating a new mentor on the Clementine (mentorAI) platform [[535068673]]:

---

## Creating a New Mentor on Clementine (mentorAI)

### Step 1: Start a New Mentor
- From your **dashboard**, click the **"New Mentor"** button.

---

### Step 2: Input Mentor Information
Fill in the following fields:

1. **Name** — Enter the mentor's name. This will be the primary identifier for mentees looking to connect.
2. **Description** — Write a brief bio covering the mentor's background, skills, and what type of mentorship they offer (e.g., career advice, skill development).
3. **Category** — Select the appropriate category based on the mentor's expertise (e.g., Astronomy, Art, Anthropology). This helps mentees find relevant mentors.
4. **Mentor Visibility** — Choose whether the mentor will be visible to all students, select groups, or kept private.
5. **Image** — Optionally upload a professional profile picture to enhance engagement and make the profile more relatable.

---

### Step 3: Configure Prompts
Set up the interaction prompts for the mentor:

1. **System Prompts** — Review and optionally modify the pre-populated prompts that define how the mentor should interact with mentees.
2. **Proactive Prompts** — Add engagement prompts to initiate discussions with mentees. Tailor these to encourage specific types of interactions.
3. **Guided Prompts** — Set structured guidance for conversations, relevant to the mentor's expertise and the mentee's needs.

> 💡 **Tip:** Add your configured prompts at the bottom of the default prompts for more effective mentoring.

---

### Step 4: Save
- Click the **"Save"** button to submit and publish the new mentor profile.

---

For additional configuration options (e.g., fine-tuning settings and behavior), you can also refer to the **mentorAI Settings & Options** page on Confluence.

---

**Sources:**
- [mentorAI Creating A Mentor](https://answers.atlassian.syr.edu/wiki/spaces/ITSAI/pages/535068673/mentorAI+Creating+A+Mentor) [[535068673]]
